title: Walls, fences and structures no higher than 0.75 m within 1.5 m where two streets intersect
text: Walls, fences and other structures truncated or reduced to no higher than 0.75m within 1.5m of where ... two streets intersect (refer Figure 3.8a).
notes: Applies to corner lots. site.corner_sightline_clear_0_75m (proposed). verify: the clause runs the driveway and street-corner cases together.

verified.note: p43 the clause runs the driveway and street-corner cases together; Figure 3.8a shows 1.5 m sight lines and a separate 1 m x 1 m lot truncation at the corner.
